<blockquote>
<p>一个<strong>纯 <code>Three.js（r160 ES Module）+ ECharts</code></strong> 驱动的科技感 3D 可视化 Demo。本文拆解它的整体架构与 7 个核心技术点，所有代码片段均可直接复制复用。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<p><strong>效果图</strong>：</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b533af240b584adfa517e0890c2b06dd~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgU3RyYXllcg==:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788851471&amp;x-signature=CWYBlXzD%2BV3lzs3a0CoWPchIVDE%3D" alt="2026-07-21-14-02-22_高压缩.awebp" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>GitHub 仓库：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fweiweiweigang%2Ftopo-big-screen1" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/weiweiweigang/topo-big-screen1" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/weiweiweiga…</a></li>
<li>在线 Demo：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fweiweiweigang.github.io%2Ftopo-big-screen1%2F" target="_blank" title="https://weiweiweigang.github.io/topo-big-screen1/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">weiweiweigang.github.io/topo-big-sc…</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">一、项目背景与定位</h3>
<p>这是一套<strong>以科技感与炫酷视觉为第一目标</strong>的 3D 数据大屏 Demo：在真实地理底图之上，叠加供热管网拓扑与 3D 空间管路，呈现"地图 + 拓扑 + 3D"一体的可视化效果。</p>
<p>它的定位很明确——<strong>一个可复用的效果合集</strong>，而不是某个特定工业系统的前端。你看到哪段效果合适（比如双层光晕管道、对向粒子流、相机微摆、高空引擎扫描），直接把对应代码复制走即可。</p>
<ul>
<li>技术底座：真实邯郸市行政区划 GeoJSON + 136 段真实管网拓扑（Web Mercator 坐标）</li>
<li>视觉要素：深色科技风、发光管网、流动粒子、高空计算引擎扫描、辉光后处理</li>
<li>性质：纯前端 Demo，无后端依赖，改一行就能本地预览</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">二、技术栈与整体架构</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-3">2.1 模块职责划分</h4>


















































<table><thead><tr><th>模块</th><th>文件</th><th>职责</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>SceneManager</strong>（编排者）</td><td><code>three-scene.js</code></td><td>舞台搭建 + 每帧编排，调度其余所有业务模块，<strong>不写业务</strong></td></tr><tr><td><strong>NetworkBuilder</strong></td><td><code>NetworkBuilder.js</code></td><td>站点节点、真实管道曲线、流动粒子、告警/呼吸动画</td></tr><tr><td><strong>ComputeEngine</strong></td><td><code>computeEngine/index.js</code></td><td>高空实时计算引擎 + 定时扫描特效 + 方案切换（编排类）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>MapBuilder</strong></td><td><code>map.js</code></td><td>GeoJSON 区县挤出、边界发光线、坐标投影工具</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Background</strong></td><td><code>background.js</code></td><td>渐变底色 + 发光网格 + 漂浮粒子</td></tr><tr><td><strong>OverlayManager</strong></td><td><code>overlay.js</code></td><td>浮层面板（指标/告警/图表/详情弹窗）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>数据层</strong></td><td><code>data.js</code> + <code>data/*.json</code></td><td>站点/告警数据、拓扑线、行政区划 GeoJSON</td></tr><tr><td><strong>入口</strong></td><td><code>main.js</code></td><td>初始化、异步加载、动画循环</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">2.2 生命周期与数据流</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-mermaid" lang="mermaid">flowchart TD
    A[main.js 入口] --&gt; B[new SceneManager]
    A --&gt; C[OverlayManager]
    B --&gt; D[scene.init&lt;br/&gt;MapBuilder.load handan_geo.json]
    D --&gt; E[scene.buildNetwork networkData]
    E --&gt; F[NetworkBuilder.buildNetwork]
    F --&gt; F1[fetch topology_line.json]
    F1 --&gt; F2[供水 _chainSegments → CatmullRom]
    F2 --&gt; F3[回水 _offsetCurveLateral]
    F3 --&gt; F4[_createMergedPipe 双层管]
    F3 --&gt; F5[_createPathParticles 粒子]
    E --&gt; G[ComputeEngine.create 高空引擎]
    E --&gt; H[Background 背景增强]
    B --&gt; I[animate loop: scene.update delta]
    I --&gt; I1[撤销微摆 → controls.update]
    I1 --&gt; I2[network/engine/background.update]
    I2 --&gt; I3[composer.render + labelRenderer.render]
</code></pre>
<p>关键设计：<strong><code>SceneManager</code> 只"搭台 + 报幕"，把构建（build）与每帧推进（update）委托出去</strong>。每个子模块拿到 <code>scene / camera / controls</code> 引用，自己管理自己的 Mesh 与动画，互不耦合。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">2.3 场景编排者</h4>
<p><code>SceneManager</code> 在构造时一次性初始化场景、相机、渲染器、标签渲染器、控制器、灯光、后处理、拾取，并把业务模块注入：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// three-scene.js（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">network</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">NetworkBuilder</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controls</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">engine</span>  = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ComputeEngine</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controls</span>);
</code></pre>
<p>每帧只做四件事——撤销上一帧相机微摆、更新控制器、推进业务动画、渲染：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(<span class="hljs-params">delta</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_lastSway</span>) { <span class="hljs-comment">/* 撤销上一帧微摆偏移 */</span> }
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controls</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_userInteracting</span>) { <span class="hljs-comment">/* 叠加相机微摆 */</span> }
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">network</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(delta);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">engine</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(delta);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">background</span>) <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">background</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(delta);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">composer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>();
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">labelRenderer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">三、核心技术点深挖</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">3.1 真实管网拓扑的曲线化</h4>
<p>原始数据是<strong>离散的管道段</strong>（每段有 <code>connId1 / connId2</code> 端点 id 和首尾坐标）。要画一条连续的流体管道，得先把段"串"成一条路径，再做平滑。</p>
<p><strong>供水：按连接关系链段 + Catmull-Rom 平滑</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// NetworkBuilder._chainSegments（节选思路）</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 用 connId 建立索引：哪些段接在端点 A、端点 B</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 找起点：connId1 没出现在任何段的 connId2 中</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 正向追踪 + 反向追踪，拼出有序段序列</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 取每段的端点生成有序点列</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">CatmullRomCurve3</span>(points, <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'catmullrom'</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>);
</code></pre>
<p><strong>回水：复用供水曲线，固定方向偏移</strong></p>
<p>回水管道和供水几乎平行，但<strong>不能逐点做管线的法向偏移</strong>——拐弯处相邻段的法向突变会让回水曲线"扭曲/自交"。项目用了一个很稳的近似：<strong>用整条曲线的首尾连线算一个全局侧向方向，整体平移</strong>。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// NetworkBuilder._offsetCurveLateral</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">_offsetCurveLateral</span>(<span class="hljs-params">curve, lateralOffset, yOffset</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pts = curve.<span class="hljs-property">points</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> up = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector3</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 整条曲线整体走向</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> overallDir = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector3</span>()
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">subVectors</span>(pts[pts.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>], pts[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]).<span class="hljs-title function_">normalize</span>();
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 走向 × up = 固定的侧向法线方向</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> fixedNormal = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector3</span>()
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">crossVectors</span>(overallDir, up).<span class="hljs-title function_">normalize</span>();

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> offsetPoints = pts.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">p</span> =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector3</span>(
    p.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> + fixedNormal.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> * lateralOffset,   <span class="hljs-comment">// 侧向 0.8</span>
    yOffset,                                <span class="hljs-comment">// 降低 Y 0.3</span>
    p.<span class="hljs-property">z</span> + fixedNormal.<span class="hljs-property">z</span> * lateralOffset
  ));
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">CatmullRomCurve3</span>(offsetPoints, <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'catmullrom'</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>经验</strong>：当"平行偏移"在局部会自交时，退一步用全局方向偏移，牺牲物理精确换视觉稳定，对大屏完全够用。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">3.2 双层管渲染与透明排序</h4>
<p>一条管道要同时具备"实体感"和"科技光晕感"，还要让粒子在管中流动可见。最终方案是<strong>三层叠加</strong>：</p>

































<table><thead><tr><th>层</th><th>几何</th><th>材质</th><th>renderOrder</th><th>作用</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>内层管</td><td><code>TubeGeometry(r=0.08)</code></td><td><code>MeshStandardMaterial</code> 不透明、发光、<code>depthWrite:false</code></td><td>5</td><td>管道实体</td></tr><tr><td>外壳</td><td><code>TubeGeometry(r=0.3)</code></td><td><code>MeshBasicMaterial</code> 半透明(opacity 0.1)、<code>depthWrite:false</code>、<code>DoubleSide</code></td><td>10</td><td>光晕</td></tr><tr><td>粒子</td><td><code>SphereGeometry(r=0.15)</code></td><td><code>MeshBasicMaterial</code>、<code>depthWrite:false</code></td><td>5</td><td>流动介质</td></tr></tbody></table>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 内层（管道实体）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> innerMesh = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Mesh</span>(
  <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">TubeGeometry</span>(curve, tubularSegments, <span class="hljs-number">0.08</span>, <span class="hljs-number">8</span>, <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>),
  <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">MeshStandardMaterial</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>:<span class="hljs-number">0x1a2a44</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">emissive</span>: color,
    <span class="hljs-attr">emissiveIntensity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">metalness</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.8</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">roughness</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">transparent</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">opacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1.0</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">depthWrite</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span> })
);
innerMesh.<span class="hljs-property">renderOrder</span> = <span class="hljs-number">5</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 外壳（光晕，不写深度避免遮挡粒子）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> outerMesh = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Mesh</span>(
  <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">TubeGeometry</span>(curve, tubularSegments, <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">12</span>, <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>),
  <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">MeshBasicMaterial</span>({ color, <span class="hljs-attr">transparent</span>:<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">opacity</span>:<span class="hljs-number">0.1</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">depthWrite</span>:<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">side</span>: <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">DoubleSide</span> })
);
outerMesh.<span class="hljs-property">renderOrder</span> = <span class="hljs-number">10</span>;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么要手动控 <code>renderOrder</code> 并关 <code>depthWrite</code>？</strong>
透明物体的默认深度排序在管网这种"互相穿插 + 半透明壳"的场景下必定出错。项目的约定是：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">区县面 (depthWrite:false, renderOrder:<span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
  → 管道内层 + 粒子 (renderOrder:<span class="hljs-number">5</span>)
    → 管道外壳 (renderOrder:<span class="hljs-number">10</span>)
</code></pre>
<p>即：<strong>先画底层半透明区县（不写深度）→ 再画管道与粒子 → 最后画最外层光晕壳</strong>。配合全链路 <code>depthWrite:false</code>，半透明之间不再互相"吃掉"对方，辉光也始终罩在最外。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-9">3.3 粒子流对向动画</h4>
<p>供水与回水要呈现"对向流动"。粒子沿 <code>CatmullRomCurve3</code> 用 <code>getPointAt(t)</code> 取位置，<code>t</code> 在 <code>[0,1]</code> 循环：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// NetworkBuilder._createPathParticles + update（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">particles</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">p</span> =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">reverse</span>) {            <span class="hljs-comment">// 回水：t 递减</span>
    p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">t</span> -= p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">speed</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">t</span> &lt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">t</span> += <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {                             <span class="hljs-comment">// 供水：t 递增</span>
    p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">t</span> += p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">speed</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">t</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">t</span> -= <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
  }
  p.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">copy</span>(p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">curve</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getPointAt</span>(p.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span>.<span class="hljs-property">t</span>));
});
</code></pre>
<p>因回水曲线是供水曲线的偏移副本，两者共享同一套参数空间，<code>t</code> 同向即同路径、反向即"迎面而来"，视觉上天然形成环路对流。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">3.4 呼吸 / 告警动画的 smootherstep 缓动</h4>
<p>首站发光、告警脉冲这类"柔和起伏"没有用简单的 <code>sin</code>，而是套了一层 <strong>smootherstep</strong>——零阶/一阶/二阶导数在端点都为 0，过渡比 sin 更"稳"，不会有突变感：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// NetworkBuilder.update（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> breathTime = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">0.003</span>;          <span class="hljs-comment">// ~2 秒周期</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">breathingObjects</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">obj</span> =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> t = (<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(breathTime + (obj.<span class="hljs-property">phase</span> || <span class="hljs-number">0</span>)) + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 0→1</span>
  t = t * t * t * (t * (t * <span class="hljs-number">6</span> - <span class="hljs-number">15</span>) + <span class="hljs-number">10</span>);             <span class="hljs-comment">// smootherstep</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (obj.<span class="hljs-property">isOpacity</span>)
    obj.<span class="hljs-property">mat</span>.<span class="hljs-property">opacity</span> = obj.<span class="hljs-property">baseOpacity</span> + obj.<span class="hljs-property">amplitude</span> * t;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>
    obj.<span class="hljs-property">mat</span>.<span class="hljs-property">emissiveIntensity</span> = obj.<span class="hljs-property">baseEmissive</span> + obj.<span class="hljs-property">amplitude</span> * t;
});
</code></pre>
<p>告警脉冲环则是 <code>sin</code> 直接驱动缩放 + 透明度：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> time = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">0.003</span>;
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">alarmObjects</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">obj</span> =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (obj.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'ring'</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scale = <span class="hljs-number">1</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(time) * <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>;
    obj.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(scale, scale, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
    obj.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">material</span>.<span class="hljs-property">opacity</span> = obj.<span class="hljs-property">baseOpacity</span> * (<span class="hljs-number">0.5</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(time) * <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>);
  }
});
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-11">3.5 相机微摆与 OrbitControls 的"共生"</h4>
<p>大屏静止时希望相机有轻微"呼吸式"晃动增加生命力；但用户一旦拖拽，就必须立刻停摆、且<strong>绝不能破坏用户的 OrbitControls 状态</strong>。</p>
<p>最巧妙的是这段"先撤销、再交给控制器、最后叠加"的逻辑：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// three-scene.js SceneManager.update（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(<span class="hljs-params">delta</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ① 撤销上一帧的微摆偏移，让控制器基于"干净位置"计算</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_lastSway</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> -= <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_lastSway</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> -= <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_lastSway</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">z</span> -= <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_lastSway</span>.<span class="hljs-property">z</span>;
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ② 控制器更新（阻尼、用户拖拽都在这步生效）</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controls</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>();

  <span class="hljs-comment">// ③ 未交互时叠加微摆；交互时清空缓存</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_userInteracting</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> t = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">0.00105</span>;     <span class="hljs-comment">// ~6 秒周期</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sx = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(t) * <span class="hljs-number">2.0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sy = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(t * <span class="hljs-number">0.7</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">1.0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sz = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">cos</span>(t) * <span class="hljs-number">2.0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> += sx;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> += sy;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">z</span> += sz;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">lookAt</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controls</span>.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_lastSway</span> = { <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: sx, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: sy, <span class="hljs-attr">z</span>: sz };   <span class="hljs-comment">// 记录本次偏移，供下帧撤销</span>
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_lastSway</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ...</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么能"共生"而不打架？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>每帧先把上一帧的偏移<strong>减回去</strong>，控制器永远在"无微摆"的基准位姿上工作，用户的拖拽/缩放不会被叠加量污染；</li>
<li>微摆量每帧记录、下帧撤销，形成"净零"回路；</li>
<li>交互检测用 <code>controls</code> 的 <code>start/end</code> 事件 + 2 秒空闲计时：拖拽期间 <code>_userInteracting = true</code> 直接跳过叠加，松手 2 秒后才恢复微摆。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-12">3.6 高空计算引擎：编排模式与预设切换</h4>
<p>"实时计算引擎"模块用<strong>组合预设</strong>管理复杂度：引擎本体 / 向下流光 / 扩散光圈三要素各有多套实现，按 <code>1/2/3/4</code> 整体切换。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// computeEngine/index.js（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 三要素各有多套方案，按组合预设切换</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">//   1 稳·现状   → A+A+A     2 干净锐利 → D+D+C</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">//   3 数据流动   → C+C+D     4 扫描雷达感 → E+B+B</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">setPreset</span>(<span class="hljs-params">n</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable constant_">PRESETS</span>[n]) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scheme</span> = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">PRESETS</span>[n];
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">_disposeEngine</span>();                       <span class="hljs-comment">// 销毁旧引擎（dispose 几何/材质/标签）</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">engineGroup</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>();
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">engineGroup</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_cx</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_cy</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_cz</span>);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">_buildEngine</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scheme</span>.<span class="hljs-property">engine</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">engineGroup</span>);  <span class="hljs-comment">// 按新方案重建</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 重建标签 + 清空进行中扫描特效</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>_buildEngine</code> 把具体构造委托给 <code>engines/reactor.js / points.js / fresnel.js / morph.js</code>，<code>_triggerScan</code> 委托给 <code>scan.js</code>——<strong>编排类只调度、不实现</strong>，切换方案时整组销毁重建，杜绝旧方案的网格/粒子残留。其中方案 E 的"多态核心"还能在每次扫描脉冲时切到下一形态（立方晶阵→二十面体→八面体→魔方循环），用 smoothstep 做形态间融合过渡。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-13">3.7 后处理辉光与拾取交互</h4>
<p><strong>辉光</strong>用 <code>UnrealBloomPass</code> 给所有发光材质统一"泛光"，科技感的主要来源：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// three-scene.js _initPostProcessing</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">composer</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EffectComposer</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">composer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addPass</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RenderPass</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>));
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">composer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addPass</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UnrealBloomPass</span>(
  <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector2</span>(w, h), <span class="hljs-number">0.6</span> <span class="hljs-comment">/* strength */</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span> <span class="hljs-comment">/* radius */</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.15</span> <span class="hljs-comment">/* threshold */</span>
));
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">composer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addPass</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">OutputPass</span>());
</code></pre>
<p><strong>拾取</strong>用 <code>Raycaster</code> 命中节点或管道的交互代理（供水管道每段一个不可见 <code>TubeGeometry</code> 代理，<code>opacity:0</code> 供点击）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// three-scene.js _initRaycaster（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> targets = [...<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">network</span>.<span class="hljs-property">nodeMeshes</span>, ...<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">network</span>.<span class="hljs-property">pipeMeshes</span>];
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> intersects = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">raycaster</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">intersectObjects</span>(targets, <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
<span class="hljs-comment">// 向上回溯到带 userData.nodeData / pipeData 的祖先</span>
</code></pre>
<p>命中后通过 <code>scene.onNodeClick</code> 回调把数据交给 <code>OverlayManager</code> 弹出详情面板，ECharts 图表也由它负责渲染。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">四、总结与可扩展方向</h3>
<p>这套大屏的架构可以浓缩成一句话：<strong><code>SceneManager</code> 搭台报幕，业务模块各管一摊，靠 import 链把场景基础设施与业务构建解耦。</strong></p>
<p>值得复用的几个模式：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>编排者模式</strong>：把"场景基础设施"和"业务构建/动画"彻底分离，子模块拿引用、自管理；</li>
<li><strong>全局方向偏移代替逐点法向</strong>：平行管线在转弯处的稳定方案；</li>
<li><strong><code>renderOrder</code> + <code>depthWrite:false</code> 三段式</strong>：半透明层级场景的排序铁律；</li>
<li><strong>相机微摆的"净零回路"</strong>：先撤销→控制器更新→再叠加，与 OrbitControls 无冲突共存；</li>
<li><strong>组合预设 + 整体销毁重建</strong>：多方案可视化切换的干净做法。</li>
</ol>
<p>可继续扩展的方向：</p>
<ul>
<li>接入自己的数据源：替换 <code>data/topology_line.json</code> 与 <code>data/handan_geo.json</code>，把 <code>networkData</code> 换成你的拓扑/节点数据；</li>
<li>用 <code>InstancedMesh</code> 替代逐粒子 <code>Mesh</code>，把 25×N 个粒子压成一个 draw call；</li>
<li>把 <code>lngLatToScene</code> 抽成通用投影层，支持多城市切换。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
